rules.title: Record required follow-up
rules.instruction: When required work falls outside the authorized scope, record it through Avoozl instead of only mentioning it. Do not silently broaden the current task.

rules.title: Review substantive risks
rules.instruction: Prioritize correctness, feasibility, security, and missing acceptance coverage. Do not prolong review with purely stylistic nitpicks.

rules.title: Complete with evidence
rules.instruction: Record the commit and relevant check results. Keep agent completion, integration, and acceptance as separate states.
